name: treesitter
description: Tree-sitter CLI for parsing and analyzing source code with incremental parsing

treesitter-parse.description: Self-contained tree-sitter parser with embedded Python + 26 languages (NO external dependencies)
treesitter-parse.usage:
treesitter-parse python script.py # Parse Python with structure analysis
treesitter-parse bash script.sh # Parse bash script
treesitter-parse yaml config.yaml # Parse YAML configuration
treesitter-parse rust main.rs # Parse Rust code

treesitter-parse-fallback.description: Fallback parser (requires system Python or micromamba)
treesitter-parse-fallback.usage: treesitter-parse-fallback python script.py # Use if embedded version fails
